description: Flat metadata schema for individual reagents used in fluorescent staining imaging experiments on cultured cell lines, including dyes and secondary antibodies, with emphasis on provenance, concentration, and batch information for reproducibility.

reagent_id.descr: Unique identifier for this reagent record within the dataset; use a stable accession or internal ID.

reagent_name.descr: Common name of the reagent, e.g., 'Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse IgG' or 'DAPI'.

reagent_type.descr: Category of reagent; allowed values include fluorescent dye, secondary antibody, counterstain, blocking reagent, wash reagent, or other staining reagent.

target_analyte.descr: Specific binding target or staining target, e.g., 'mouse IgG', 'nuclei', 'actin'; use 'none' for non-targeted dyes if appropriate.

fluorophore_name.descr: Fluorophore associated with the reagent, if applicable, e.g., FITC, Alexa Fluor 488, Cy3, DAPI.

emission_max_nm.descr: Peak emission wavelength of the fluorophore in nanometers (nm), if known.

excitation_max_nm.descr: Peak excitation wavelength of the fluorophore in nanometers (nm), if known.

supplier_name.descr: Manufacturer or vendor source of the reagent.

catalog_number.descr: Supplier catalog or product number used to order the reagent.

batch_lot_number.descr: Batch, lot, or lot-like production identifier for the reagent.

reagent_version.descr: Version, clone, or formulation identifier when applicable, especially for antibodies or proprietary dyes.

host_species.descr: Host species for antibody production, e.g., mouse, rabbit, goat; use 'not_applicable' for dyes.

clone_name.descr: Antibody clone name or identifier, if applicable.

isotype.descr: Antibody isotype, if applicable, e.g., IgG1, IgG2a, IgM.

conjugated.descr: Whether the reagent is directly conjugated to a fluorophore or other label; true or false.

conjugate_name.descr: Name of the conjugated label, if applicable, e.g., Alexa Fluor 594, HRP, biotin.

stock_concentration_value.descr: Stock concentration numeric value as provided by the manufacturer or prepared in-house.

stock_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for stock concentration, e.g., mg/mL, µM, nM, x.

working_concentration_value.descr: Final concentration used in the staining experiment, numeric value.

working_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for working concentration, e.g., µg/mL, nM, x, dilution factor.

dilution_factor.descr: Dilution factor used to prepare the working solution, if applicable, e.g., 1:200.

solvent_or_buffer.descr: Solvent or buffer used to dilute or formulate the reagent, e.g., PBS, TBS, water, antibody diluent.

incubation_time_min.descr: Incubation time for reagent application in minutes.

incubation_condition.descr: Free-text description of incubation conditions when a single numeric value is insufficient, e.g., '30 min at room temperature in dark'.

light_sensitive.descr: Whether the reagent must be protected from light during handling or incubation.

cross_adsorbed.descr: Whether the antibody was cross-adsorbed to reduce non-specific binding; true or false.

fixation_compatible.descr: Whether the reagent is compatible with fixed-cell staining workflows; true or false.

permeabilization_required.descr: Whether permeabilization is required for reagent access to its target; true or false.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Recommended storage temperature in degrees Celsius (°C).

storage_condition.descr: Storage condition description, e.g., 'aliquoted, protected from light, avoid freeze-thaw cycles'.

expiry_date.descr: Manufacturer or assigned expiration date for the reagent, if available.

preparation_date.descr: Date the working solution or aliquot was prepared, if applicable.

prepared_by.descr: Identifier or name of the person who prepared the reagent or working solution.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the reagent passed internal quality control or acceptance criteria for the experiment.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text quality control notes, deviations, or observations relevant to reagent performance.

notes.descr: Additional free-text comments relevant to reagent identity, use, or interpretation.
